reference.note: Reference fidelity is every native frame inside the window. It is the comparison baseline, NOT ground truth; the reviewed field below is the truth.

review.method: Every window was inspected frame by frame at native rate in the killfeed ROI before freezing. `reviewed_instants_ms` lists the instants actually looked at; no claim is made about instants between them.

reviewed.note: Two clean onsets. A death banner (KILLED BY CLOVE) is on screen at 202000 and the widget is still drawn.
No onset is claimed here: a magenta camera wipe covers the ROI at 506200-506400, so the entry may predate the wipe. Entry presence after 506620 is reviewed and certain.
Mid-round play with no killfeed activity at any reviewed instant. Ability light (a green wash, a blue beam) crosses the world but not the killfeed tray.

Buy phase with the scoreboard held open. The COMBAT REPORT panel and a KILLED BY RAZE spray card occupy the killfeed ROI for the whole window -- a confuser, not a killfeed row. The stored 2 Hz reader reports zero entries here and is right.

A green/violet respawn wipe sweeps the killfeed ROI at 504000-504620. No killfeed row is present at any reviewed instant. The stored 2 Hz read recorded THREE entries at 504000: a false positive produced by the wipe.

A vertical camera wipe with a bright green band crosses the ROI at 859000-860220. No killfeed row is present at any reviewed instant. The stored 2 Hz read recorded FOUR entries at 859000: a false positive produced by the wipe.

killfeed_entry.why: The onset tolerance is not tighter than the 200 ms review granularity that established it. Presence recall is measured only at reviewed instants.

minimap_self_position.why: Agreement with the native-rate reference at SHARED frames isolates reader state from frame choice: a lower tier's frames are a subset of the reference's.

limits: One session, one map. These windows freeze an evaluation, not a corpus.
Reference fidelity is the same detector at a higher rate. Agreement with it is not accuracy; the reviewed field is the only truth here.
Presence recall is scored at reviewed instants only, never at instants nobody looked at.
